subject: Quick 30-min walkthrough: prompts & cost tips for your embeddings surge
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Quick 30-min walkthrough: prompts & cost tips for your embeddings surge

Hi Sam,

I noticed Acme Analytics crossed a meaningful embeddings threshold this week (congrats!). We often see a couple of quick wins at this stage that reduce per-embedding cost and improve retrieval accuracy — worth a short, targeted session.

Would you be open to a 30-minute walkthrough where we can: 
- Review how youre batching/embedding (prefixes, chunking, batching)
- Share a couple of prompt templates and quantization recommendations for cost savings
- Map next steps (SE follow-up for integration)

I can do any of the following (Pacific):
- Thu Mar 16, 10:00–10:30 
- Thu Mar 16, 14:00–14:30
- Fri Mar 17, 09:00–09:30

Or pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/set-30min

Im attaching a one-pager that outlines what we cover (redwood-one-pager.pdf). If youd like an engineering deep-dive, I can loop in Olga (solutions engineer) — otherwise we can keep it high-level. Also curious who from your side would join (product/infra/ML ops).

Best,
Marcus Lin
SDR, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Sam Patel <sam@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T19:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick 30-min walkthrough: prompts & cost tips for your embeddings surge

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the heads up. We did see a jump after onboarding a couple of new pipelines; timing is good.

A couple quick Qs before we lock time: 
1) Can you confirm Redwoods SOC 2 status for PII handling? (our security team will ask)
2) For the session, Lena (ML infra lead) would want a short technical window — shes in PST as well. She and I could do Fri Mar 17 between 09:00–11:00 (PST).

If Olga can join for 10–15 minutes near the end to talk KV caching and batching, thatd be great.

Thanks Sam — great context, and happy to align with Fri the 17th. Ill lock 09:00–09:30 PST unless you prefer 09:30.

Looping in Marissa (AM) and Olga (SE). Olga can cover KV cache behavior and batching patterns for 10–15 mins, and Marissa will run the kickoff and next-steps discussion.

Attached is a short agenda weve found useful (meeting-agenda.md):
- 0–10: current setup & observed spike
- 10–20: quick optimizations (batching, prefixing, quantization tradeoffs)
- 20–30: SE recommendations + next steps

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721 (weve added notes and the usage spike metric).

If Fri 09:00 PST works, Ill send a calendar invite. If not, propose a time and Ill update.

Thanks,
Marcus
